title: Job Application for Platform Engineer, Billing at Northwind Robotics
text:
Back to jobs
Platform Engineer, Billing
Remote, Poland
Apply
Northwind Robotics builds the robots that keep warehouses moving. We are a remote-first team of 300 people.
An overview of this role
The Platform Engineer owns the billing platform: invoicing, usage metering and payment integrations.
What you'll do
Design and run the services that turn robot usage into invoices.
Keep the card and bank-transfer integrations fast and correct.
What you'll bring
Several years of backend experience in Go or Java.
Comfort with SQL and event-driven systems.
Poland Salary Range
PLN 25,000 - 32,000 per month
Northwind Robotics is an equal opportunity employer.
